correctness.rationale: Every 2x2 rectangular tile has gp_3 at most 2; every 3x2/2x3 tile at most 3, with only alternating 3-vertex masks (101,010) or (010,101); every 3x3 tile at most 5 by the adjacent-column constraints. Tiling m=2a+3epsilon, n=2b+3delta yields upper (mn+epsilon*delta)/2; coordinate checkerboard meets geodesics length<=3 in at most two points and attains it. Equality on a three-row strip forces each 3x2 tile to be one of two phases, while adjoining mismatched phases form a forbidden triple; odd final column selects the unique larger parity class. Independently recomputed small tile forbidden triples and 3xn maximizers; finite tests corroborate the complete tiling/propagation proof.
